standard_prerequisites.name: Partial flag varieties as iterated projective space bundles
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The standard description of the partial flag variety as an iterated projective space bundle over the Grassmannian and over the base field
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the auxiliary scheme over which both projections become compositions of projective space bundles.

core_obligations: Base case (proof lines 5231-5234): for the extreme cases of the Grassmannian the projection is a projective space bundle, so the compatibility follows from the corresponding lemma.

Reduce to the flag variety (proof lines 5234-5249): in general take the partial flag variety; both its morphism to the Grassmannian and its structure morphism to the base field are compositions of projective space bundles, so the auxiliary scheme is the product of the given scheme with the flag variety.

Conclude (proof lines 5249-5255): every cycle on the product with the Grassmannian is the pushforward of a cycle on the product with the flag variety, so the compatibility for the two morphisms out of the auxiliary scheme implies the compatibility for the projection.
proof_roadmap: Handle the extreme Grassmannians as projective space bundles.
Introduce the partial flag variety to make both projections iterated projective space bundles.
Push cycles down from the flag variety to conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying the first seven axioms the cycle class map commutes with pushforward along the projection from the product of a nonempty equidimensional scheme with a Grassmannian (statement lines 5227-5234). The proof (proof lines 5235-5255) handles the extreme cases as projective space bundles and reduces the general case to the partial flag variety, over which both relevant morphisms are iterated projective space bundles. H2: a complete reduction in two steps.
